description: Unified prompt contract for generating smooth, slow-motion commercial fashion videos using Google Veo 3.1 with strict motion safety boundaries.
role_and_system_directive: You are a luxury fashion commercial film director. Your objective is to animate the static catalog image into a seamless, high-end 4K commercial fashion reel with subtle, elegant motion, zero facial morphing, zero garment distortion, and controlled camera moves.

start_frame.description: High-resolution catalog try-on image serving as the initial keyframe and ground truth for identity, dress, and scene.

end_frame_optional.description: Secondary keyframe for interpolation if executing a dual-frame turnaround.

prompt_template.system_prefix: Cinematic slow-motion luxury fashion commercial video of the South Asian woman wearing the couture garment.
prompt_template.camera_and_lighting: Smooth slow camera dolly-in with subtle upward tilt, high-end 3200K warm studio key light casting soft specular highlights on antique gold zari embroidery and micro-sequins.
prompt_template.model_and_motion: The model holds an elegant, poised standing posture facing the camera with minimal slow-motion settling: subtle natural breathing motion, delicate finger relaxation, and faint sway of the circular skirt hem. {{DYNAMIC_GARMENT_MOTION}}
prompt_template.motion_safety_rules: Strictly front-facing. Zero full spins or fast turns. Zero facial morphing, zero identity drift. Background remains stationary champagne pleated silk. 4K photorealistic broadcast fashion reel.
prompt_template.negative_constraints: wild spins, 360 rotation, side profile reveal, rear reveal in front clip, face morphing, flickering, jitter, sudden jumps, garment redesign, extra limbs, background movement, cartoon, CGI, watermark.

DYNAMIC_GARMENT_MOTION.example: The asymmetric cowl drape and hanging micro-bead fringe catch the light with subtle micro-movements as the deep wine maroon georgette settles softly.

three_ws_guidelines.what_to_enforce: Front-facing constraint; subtle slow-motion only (< 5% body shift); stationary champagne satin background; temporal identity coherence.
three_ws_guidelines.when_to_apply: Applied during all Veo 3.1 video clip generations.
three_ws_guidelines.why_and_remediation: Video diffusion models hallucinate missing backs or distort faces during rapid rotations. Remediation: Generate separate front and rear clips, and cross-fade in video post-processing.
